content_sections.heading: SDDMASC Junior Resident Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SDDMASC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SDDMASC Junior Resident Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Resident: MBBS Degree from an institution recognized by MCI. Must have completed one-year rotatory internship/passed FMG examination. Experience: Completed one-year rotatory internship/passed FMG examination within 2 years from date of interview. Candidates who have completed one-year rotatory internship/passed FMG examination for more than 2 years from the date of interview may also be considered in case of non-availability of fresh candidates on Adhoc basis for 44 days or till the regular/Adhoc (Fresh) candidate is appointed whichever is earlier. Fresh candidates are those who have not done Junior Residency or have completed less than one year residency.

rows.category: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Junior Resident: Maximum age limit is 30 years for General candidates. Age Relaxation: SC/ST: 5 years OBC: 3 years Persons with disabilities (Divyangjan): 5 years

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Resident: Level 10 of pay matrix with basic pay Rs.56,100/-, other usual allowances as admissible under the rules.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SDDMASC Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SDDMASC Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Resident posts is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates must report for registration between 9 AM and 11:30 AM on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree from an institution recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) and have completed one year of rotatory internship or passed the FMG examination.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Resident position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies announced for the Junior Resident posts at Shri Dada Dev Matri Avum Shishu Chikitsalaya.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for General category candidates is 30 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and Persons with Disabilities (Divyangjan) candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be appointed at Level 10 of the pay matrix, with a basic pay of Rs. 56,100/-, along with other usual allowances as admissible under the rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to report directly to the venue on the specified date and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Room No. 201, 2nd floor, Administrative Block, Shri Dada Dev Matri Avum Shishu Chikitsalaya, New Delhi - 110045.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, internship completion certificate, and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment for the Junior Resident posts is on a temporary basis.
